metadata.scope: One study, grouped by exact model version, reasoning effort and reported prompt condition. Runtime/batch provenance retained as metadata. Descriptive attempt-weighted pooling, not a randomized causal hint estimate.
limitations: 38 known duplicate baseline records removed using exact trial identities. Raw identities for the 780 published hinted observations are unavailable locally; these remain aggregate-only evidence.
Luna High no-hint has 40 trials: four entropy-anomaly trials and three for each other task. Other pooled settings have three or six trials per task.

Five historical pre-agent setup records were replaced in the published 780 matrix; one later setup failure and two administrative interruptions remain in the High schedule. This protocol difference is retained rather than retroactively resampling.
Client versions, CPU quotas, concurrency and calendar date differ. Hint length is not controlled.
Full cost is unknown whenever any component is incomplete. Conservative upper reserves are not confirmed spending. Exact frontiers omit incomplete-cost settings.
Three DeepSeek None pilot records are preserved but excluded because only one of 13 tasks was attempted.
Initial task selection used GPT-5.6 Luna; selection outcomes differ from subsequent evaluations.
